subject: Important Update: Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, Thank you for your recent purchase with us. We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in the shipment of your order due to unforeseen circumstances. Rest assured, we are working diligently to resolve this issue and expedite the delivery process. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding. Please feel free to reach out to our customer support team for further assistance. Thank you for choosing our services. Sincerely, [Company Name]
